decisions.reason: The dismantling joint fits the core water-infrastructure fittings range, costs little to keep listed and complements valve installations, so the option stays open.
The pipe support bracket builds on established steel fabrication and pipeline supply, so keeping it costs little even though there is no recent evidence of its results.

The public waste bin is distant from the core business, but it uses existing powder-coating capacity and serves municipal customers the firm already has, so its uncertain value still justifies a low-cost option.

The waste bin with ashtray is a multi-model line distant from the core and somewhat costlier to maintain, yet results remain unobserved, so it is held as a diversification option on municipal street furniture for now.
The outdoor ashtrays share the coating and municipal channel with the bins, so the street-furniture options are kept together until clearer evidence of their value emerges.
